```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  // Collect all unique categories from publications
  const allCategories = new Set();
  document.querySelectorAll('.publication-item').forEach(item => {
    const cats = item.dataset.categories;
    if (cats) {
      cats.split(',').forEach(cat => {
        if (cat.trim()) allCategories.add(cat.trim());
      });
    }
  });

  // Sort categories alphabetically
  const sortedCategories = Array.from(allCategories).sort();

  // Add category buttons to the filter container
  const filterContainer = document.getElementById('category-filter');
  if (filterContainer && sortedCategories.length > 0) {
    sortedCategories.forEach(cat => {
      const btn = document.createElement('span');
      btn.className = 'category-filter-btn';
      btn.dataset.category = cat;
      btn.textContent = cat;
      filterContainer.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' '));
      filterContainer.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  // Filter function
  function filterByCategory(category, clickedBtn) {
    // Update active state
    document.querySelectorAll('.category-filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    clickedBtn.classList.add('active');

    // Filter publications
    document.querySelectorAll('.publication-item').forEach(item => {
      if (category === 'all') {
        item.style.display = '';
      } else {
        const itemCats = item.dataset.categories || '';
        if (itemCats.split(',').map(c => c.trim()).includes(category)) {
          item.style.display = '';
        } else {
          item.style.display = 'none';
        }
      }
    });

    // Hide section headers if all items in that section are hidden
    document.querySelectorAll('.publications-list').forEach(list => {
      const visibleItems = list.querySelectorAll('.publication-item:not([style*="display: none"])');
      const section = list.closest('section') || list.parentElement;
      const header = section ? section.querySelector('h2') : null;
      if (header) {
        header.style.display = visibleItems.length === 0 ? 'none' : '';
      }
      list.style.display = visibleItems.length === 0 ? 'none' : '';
    });
  }

  // Use event delegation on the filter container
  if (filterContainer) {
    filterContainer.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
      if (event.target.classList.contains('category-filter-btn')) {
        const category = event.target.dataset.category;
        filterByCategory(category, event.target);
      }
    });
  }
});
</script>
```
